description: Eval cases cho /wf-scan-target skill v2.0 — 12 cases coverage cho Sprint 1-7 features (compliance core, resume/checkpoint, lazy-load, bash delegation, cross-skill, multi-dev safety, profile + delta scan).

evals.name: Scan .NET DDD module (local source)
evals.expected_behavior: Phát hiện tech stack dotnet-ddd, scan entities/commands/queries/endpoints, tạo đủ 3 output files bắt buộc

evals.name: Scan Next.js ERP frontend module (local source)
evals.expected_behavior: Phát hiện tech stack nextjs, scan pages/components/hooks, note API endpoints không available (backend scope)

evals.name: Scan với --compare để tạo gap report
evals.expected_behavior: Tất cả 4 output files được tạo (including gap-report.md), gap matrix có đủ 3 status

evals.name: Error handling — missing --target
evals.expected_behavior: Hiển thị error message rõ ràng với usage instructions, KHÔNG tạo bất kỳ file nào, KHÔNG crash

evals.name: Shallow scan — chỉ file structure
evals.expected_behavior: Chỉ chạy Layer 1 (file structure), skip layers 2-4. Output có đủ headers nhưng layers 2-4 ghi 'shallow mode — skipped'

evals.name: Resume từ checkpoint (Sprint 2 — GAP-05)

input.scenario: session in_progress đã chạy xong Phase 0-1 + L1, interrupt giữa Phase 2 L2; user gọi `/wf-scan-target --resume`

evals.expected_behavior: resume-status.md CASE B dispatch: verify target_fingerprint composite (path+tech+depth+git_HEAD+git_dirty+manifests) khớp; nếu mismatch → CDG hỏi user. POST verify khớp: load intermediate/{tech-stack,l1-structure}.json hydrate state, route đến next_action.phase = phase_2.l2 (resume mid-Phase-2). KHÔNG re-run Phase 0-1 + L1. Hoàn thành L2 + L3 + L4 + Phase 3-5 bình thường. POST-GATE T1-T4 PASS.

evals.name: Profile=quick smoke scan (Sprint 7 — Q4 ADAPTIVE)
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.1c map profile=quick → scan_depth='shallow' + MAX_PAGES=5 (Q4 ADAPTIVE). Scan chỉ chạy L1 (shallow), skip L2-L4 (giống EVAL-005). Phase 5 output target-map.json có scan_profile='quick'. Completion < 30s cho module medium-size. Bash scripts (scan-target-detect.sh + scan-target-inventory.sh) chỉ chạy 2 scripts, skip api/ui/db scripts.

evals.name: Profile=exhaustive với LPM extensions (Sprint 7)
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.1c map profile=exhaustive → scan_depth='deep' + MAX_PAGES=100 + LPM ON. Phase 3.1 developer agent extract MAX 15 validators (vs 5 default). Phase 3.2 BA agent target 20-30 key_features (vs 10-20). Phase 3.2b coverage sanity check: % entities trong key_features ≥ 80% (warn nếu < 80%). Phase 4 (nếu --compare) similarity threshold 0.5 (vs 0.6 default) + fuzzy notes (mark `_fuzzy` cho similarity 0.5-0.6). target-map.json scan_profile='exhaustive'.

evals.name: Delta scan với --since=<git-ref> (Sprint 7 — GAP-13 alt)
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.2b validate --since (target=local-source + git repo + ref tồn tại). Phase 1.4b compute changed files via `git diff --name-status --find-renames=80 HEAD~5..HEAD`, filter A/M/R (skip D), persist intermediate/changed-files.json. $DELTA_MODE=true. Phase 1.5 cache lookup SKIP (delta mode → defensive cache miss). Phase 2 L1-L4 post-bash filter: jq filter chỉ giữ entries có source_file ∈ changed-files.json. layer JSON output có `delta_filtered: true`. Phase 5.5g cache write SKIP (defensive — KHÔNG thay full scan cache bằng delta subset). target-map.json có scan_profile + delta_scan {scan_mode='delta', since_ref, head_ref, total_changed_files}.

evals.name: Multi-dev concurrent scan cùng target (Sprint 6)

input.scenario: Dev A và Dev B trên cùng máy chạy cùng `/wf-scan-target --target=apps/backend/Eureka.Modules.CRM --module=crm` cách nhau vài giây cùng ngày 2026-04-28

evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.3 tạo SESSION_ID format `{YYYY-MM-DD}-{scope-label}[-{N}]` (Protocol 18.2): Dev A first → `2026-04-28-crm`, Dev B second → suffix tự tăng → `2026-04-28-crm-2`. Phase 0.3c lock check: Dev A `.lock` đã tạo trên session A; Dev B tạo session khác (no lock conflict vì khác SESSION_DIR). Cả 2 hoàn thành Phase 5 POST-GATE PASS, append _shared/scans-index.jsonl 2 entries (1 dòng / scan, JSONL append-only git-sync friendly). Cross-host scenario (Dev A trên máy 1, Dev B trên máy 2 cùng SESSION_ID) → check_lock_status return 3 (alive_cross_host) → Dev B ERROR + suggest `--output=<dir-mới>` (KHÔNG cleanup cross-host lock).

evals.name: Cache hit reuse (Sprint 6 — Q2=A)

input.scenario: Run 1: `/wf-scan-target --target=apps/backend/Eureka.Modules.CRM --module=crm` (full scan + cache write). Run 2: cùng args trong 24h, KHÔNG có --no-cache, target không thay đổi (git HEAD + dirty + manifests + tech identical → cùng fingerprint).

evals.expected_behavior: Run 1: Phase 5.5g cache write `_shared/cache/{TARGET_FINGERPRINT}.json` (sha256 hex 64 chars). Run 2 Phase 1.4 compute fingerprint giống Run 1. Phase 1.5 cache lookup: file exists + age < 24h → CACHE_HIT=true → cp cached target-map.json → SESSION_DIR + mark cache_hit=true + cache_source=fingerprint trong scan-status. save_checkpoint phase_2/3/4 = 'skipped'. Routing skip Phase 2-4, jump Phase 5.0 hydration: read cached target-map.json + hydrate state vars (L1-L4_RESULT, crud_matrix, business_rules, key_features) qua jq queries. Phase 5.1+ chạy bình thường. Run 2 hoàn thành < 5s. Bypass via --no-cache: Phase 1.5 SKIP lookup + Phase 5.5g SKIP write.

evals.name: Argument validation hardening (Sprint 7 — Q11)
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.1b argument validation hardening (Q11): enum check `--depth=shallow|deep` + `--profile=quick|standard|deep|exhaustive`, numeric check `--max-pages` 1-200 (Q4 hard cap 200 — vượt 200 phải chạy nhiều sessions với scope filter), git ref validation `git rev-parse --verify $SINCE_REF` (require ref tồn tại trong repo). Phase 0.2b conflict detection: `--since` set + target_type ∈ {url, swagger-spec} → ERROR (require target=local-source trong git repo). Mọi error message rõ ràng với hint, STOP trước khi tạo files. KHÔNG crash, KHÔNG corrupt state.
